_why: ceo's ruling on #1453 (2026-09-13): the one file that says which sessions are live. packages/agent-org/src/arm-pr.mjs reads it and types no session list; a label is refused when its session is absent from `live`, and `retired` only chooses the sentence the refusal uses. The repository's session:* labels are not the source: four of them are retired.
_rolesNotProcesses: #1951: a `live` entry is a ROLE, and `session:<name>` is a ROUTING ADDRESS -- never a process handle. Every entry used to carry `workspace: { herdr: "w6", primary: "..." }`, a tmux pane id; six of six did, NOTHING in the tree ever read one, and the roster therefore lied the moment a pane moved. The runtime registry already exists and is herdr itself: `wake.mjs`'s `readAgents` asks `herdr --session org workspace list` and `route` matches a workspace by its LABEL, which is the name below. So the pane binding was dropped rather than moved -- there was no second reader to move it for. Add no per-instance field here: `.claude/rules/agent-practices.md` already ruled the direction for the sibling label, `answer:<session>` is "one label per session, never one per instance". `started` stays because it is a ROLE fact (when this role joined the roster -- worker-tooling's 19:13Z is the hour the third engineer existed), not a process one.
